finding: Slovak firms see upside inflation risk above the euro area average
bullets: A net 61.2% of Slovak firms (n=242) saw upside risks to five-year inflation expectations, 7.2 pp above the euro area's net 54.0% (n=5,087) in wave 39 — implying tighter cost pressures for Slovak firms than peers.

The SK–EA divergence widened as Slovak firms' net balance rose mildly by 2.3 pp from wave 38, while the euro area's net balance eased by 1.3 pp over the same period — suggesting growing divergence in inflation expectations.
German firms reported a net 51.3% upside inflation risk, remaining below both Slovakia and the euro area aggregate in wave 39.
chart_subtitle: Net 61.2% of Slovak firms see upside inflation risk.
